inspectedText: A participating investigator explains evidence of fission from depleted uranium and fission products. Neutron retention, ancient U235 abundance, a moderator and sufficiently few neutron poisons enable a sustained chain. The researcher recounts xenon isotope analysis in a sample from one reactor. Modeled isotope patterns support cycling, with groundwater loss and return described as the most likely mechanism. This is an inference from preserved isotopes, not observation of ancient pulses.
